verdict.rationale: Jitsu offers an official MCP server (OAuth or headless API key) and a Management API and CLI, so an agent can run the pipeline without the dashboard: create destinations, wire up streams, inspect Live Events and edit Functions. Profile Builder stores customer profiles in the warehouse, and Functions can query the warehouse via ctx.getWarehouse. However, nothing shows an agent querying customer data directly through the API or MCP, and no audience or segment creation or activation capability is documented. missing for 10: documented agent-facing customer-data/profile query via API or MCP, audience/segment creation, audience activation/sync to destinations, independent hands-on corroboration of agent workflows
